spans.s: khambhīra-pati, Mvy 〔3702〕, or khambhara-pati, 〔3703〕 (evidently a v.l.; not in Mironov, who cites a v.l. khambhāra-pati; for 〔3703〕 Tib. miṅ dan, which I do not understand but presume means idem), some sort of royal officer, acc. to Tib. either mṅan bdag, master of imprecations (i.e. royal sorcerer?), or rṅan bdag, lord of salaries (i.e. controller, bursar?). The prior element is quite unknown.
